description: Render a 3D mesh file (STL/3MF/OBJ/PLY) to a PNG image. Headless, no GUI. Returns the PNG path/URL and the mesh bounding-box dimensions in model units.
name: render_mesh

mesh_path.description: Absolute path or filename of the mesh (e.g. part.stl) produced by the CAD sandbox

prompt.description: Short description of the part, used only by the review loop

review.description: If true AND CAD_RENDER_REVIEW_LOOP=1, send the PNG to the vision model for a geometry critique

description: Render OpenSCAD source code to a PNG using the openscad binary in headless --render mode.
name: render_openscad

description: Convert between CAD/mesh formats (STL/3MF/OBJ/PLY; STEP read is best-effort if build123d/OCP is present). Returns the output path/URL.
name: convert_cad

input_path.description: Absolute path or filename of the input model

to_format.description: Target extension without dot: stl | 3mf | obj | ply
